howTo: Click “Choose PDF files” and select two or more PDFs.
Drag the rows (or use the arrow buttons) into the order you want.
Remove any file you added by mistake.
Click “Merge PDFs” and wait for the pages to be combined.
Download the merged PDF and check the page order.
keyFacts: Merging copies page objects from each source into a new document — nothing is re-rendered or flattened.
The merged file's page order is exactly the list order, top to bottom.
Each source page keeps its own size, so A4 and Letter pages can mix freely.
Bookmarks from source files are not carried over — only the pages are merged.
The result is saved with object streams for a compact file.

limitations: At least two files are required to merge.
Interactive form fields and bookmarks from sources are not preserved.
Each file is limited to 50 MB to protect browser memory.
Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked before merging.
